create_appagent_instance: create an AppAgent instance with an app_agent, tools list, and name
run_expert_agent_task: run the expert_agent tool to send a task to an expert Agent for the app
send_task_to_expert: send a specific task to the expert Agent and receive the answer as a string
review_appagent_class: review the AppAgent class that extends App and wraps an expert agent with tools
test_expert_agent_tool: test the expert_agent method that wraps tasks in AUIMessage and runs them through the app agent
